title: RAWPrism: A Three-Task Dataset and a Unified Model for RAW-Domain Image Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.34359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research on multi-exposure fusion (MEF), multi-focus fusion (MFF), and infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) has largely focused on rendered RGB images, while unified fusion across these tasks in the RAW domain before image signal processing (ISP) remains relatively underexplored. To support research in this setting, we introduce the RAWPrism dataset, covering all three tasks, and the RAWPrism model, a lightweight unified multi-task fusion network. The RAWPrism dataset comprises 422 usable MEF scenes and 150 registered MFF pairs from our RAW captures, together with 1,500 FMB-derived IVIF samples, in which the visible RAW inputs are reconstructed by ReRAW and their RGB counterparts rendered by CycleISP. Scene-level partitions and task-specific rendering and scoring protocols connect these resources to method development and evaluation. To our knowledge, the RAWPrism model is the first to unify MEF, MFF, and IVIF directly in the RAW domain.

translated_title: RAWPrism：一个三任务数据集与RAW域图像融合的统一模型
translated_abstract: 多曝光融合（MEF）、多焦点融合（MFF）和红外-可见光图像融合（IVIF）的研究大多集中在渲染后的RGB图像上，而在图像信号处理（ISP）之前的RAW域中跨这些任务的统一融合仍然相对缺乏探索。为支持这一场景下的研究，我们引入了覆盖全部三个任务的RAWPrism数据集，以及一个轻量级的统一多任务融合网络RAWPrism模型。RAWPrism数据集包含来自我们RAW采集的422个可用MEF场景和150对配准的MFF图像对，以及1,500个源自FMB的IVIF样本，其中可见光RAW输入由ReRAW重建，其对应的RGB图像由CycleISP渲染。场景级划分以及任务特定的渲染与评分协议将这些资源与方法开发和评估相衔接。据我们所知，RAWPrism模型是首个直接在RAW域统一MEF、MFF和IVIF的模型。
tldr: 提出了覆盖多曝光融合、多焦点融合和红外-可见光融合三任务的RAWPrism数据集，并构建了首个直接在RAW域统一执行这三种融合任务的轻量级模型。
en_tdlr: We present RAWPrism, a three-task dataset covering MEF, MFF, and IVIF, together with the first lightweight unified model that performs all three fusion tasks directly in the RAW domain.
